introHtml: Made in USA no touch door opener tools combine safety and domestic manufacturing for businesses that prioritize American-made quality. Choose from carabiner clips or keychain styles with full-color imprint options. Perfect for safety managers equipping teams with reliable, USA-made hygiene tools that stand up to daily use.
